name: Create Mesh Agent
description: Create Mesh Agent — the scaffolder that writes a starter agent on the FlashyOS mesh, published as npx @flashyos/create-mesh-agent once carried out of the monorepo. AAO expands to Agentic Autonomous Organization.

roles.name: template
roles.purpose: Owns the scaffold itself — what gets written into a new agent's directory — and keeps it in sync with @flashyos/agent's current surface, so a generated starter never imports an SDK shape that no longer exists.
roles.measure: Fixture scaffolds that typecheck against the current @flashyos/agent surface, as a share of fixtures

roles.name: conformance
roles.purpose: Runs the generator against its fixtures and asserts every scaffold it writes actually installs, typechecks and passes its own starter test — a scaffold that only looks right is worse than one that visibly fails.
roles.measure: Fixture runs producing a passing starter, as a share of runs

roles.name: release
roles.purpose: Cuts versioned releases with a changelog entry, so a version says what the generator will refuse to write and never moves once it ships.
roles.measure: Releases with a changelog entry, as a share of tags

roles.name: adoption
roles.purpose: Helps a new participant get from npx to a running, mesh-registered agent, and records real scaffolds that reached a first task rather than a download count.
roles.measure: Scaffolds reaching a first mesh-registered task, as a share of scaffolds run

roles.name: review
roles.purpose: Reviews a template change before it lands, because a bad scaffold ships into every adopter's codebase at once, not just this one.
roles.measure: Template changes carrying an approving review, as a share of merges
